required_floor_classes.lane_definition: An education/workforce scenario cannot pass if student access, school enrollment access, student-aid access, training access, disability access, rural access, or adult-worker access falls below reviewed floors.
An education/workforce scenario cannot pass if lower costs are achieved by degrading learning, completion, persistence, employment outcomes, credential quality, program integrity, or learner safety.

An education/workforce scenario cannot pass if cost shifts, access loss, completion loss, aid loss, training loss, or employment loss falls disproportionately on low-income students, first-generation students, students with disabilities, rural communities, historically underserved groups, or displaced workers.

An education/workforce scenario cannot pass if funding adequacy, instructional continuity, institutional stability, labor-market transition capacity, or recession/displacement resilience falls below reviewed floors.

An education/workforce scenario cannot pass without federal/state/local translation, program-to-actual-outlay allocation, cohort timing, implementation cost, administrative capacity, and delivery-risk review.

education_workforce_specific_floor_defin.definition: Educational attainment and credential progression require sourced baseline, policy, and stress values before any lower-cost scenario can pass.
Completion, persistence, and transfer outcomes require explicit reviewed floors and cannot be inferred from spending levels alone.
Access, affordability, enrollment, aid availability, and training availability require explicit thresholds before target-cost selection.
Employment, earnings, displaced-worker transition, and training-placement outcomes require sourced floor values before policy scoring.
Distribution by income, race/ethnicity, disability, geography, first-generation status, and worker-displacement status requires reviewed floors.
No target cost can be selected without federal/state/local translation, program-to-outlay allocation, cohort timing, implementation cost, and delivery feasibility.

public_warning_phrases: This education/workforce floor packet defines required floor concepts, but it does not set threshold values or pass/fail findings.
The negative higher-education FY2025 entry is an account-reconciliation fact, not negative education, recovered waste, or savings.

No lower-cost education/workforce scenario is admissible until attainment, completion, access, employment, equity, adequacy/resilience, federal/state/local translation, and delivery-feasibility floors are thresholded, sourced, reviewed, and passed.
No target cost, federal effect, gross savings, net savings, solver input, department-cut instruction, technology-savings claim, or balanced-budget claim is populated.
No FOIA request, records request, form, email, phone call, or agency/person contact was submitted.

This record is not outcome-floor passage, not a federal/state/local translation, not a program-to-outlay allocation, not a cohort timing model, not a federal score, not a target-cost selection, not solver input, not a rate calculation, not a public rate card, not a savings estimate, not a waste finding, not a fraud finding, not a department-cut instruction, not a technology-savings claim, and not a balanced-budget claim.
